title: Hot Wheels 3 Window 34 1998 Treasure Hunt #4 Ford Coupe Limited Ed THunt Hot Rod
categoryName: Toys & Hobbies:Diecast & Toy Vehicles:Cars, Trucks & Vans:Contemporary Manufacture
descriptionText: The Hot Wheels 3 Window 34 1998 Treasure Hunt #4 Ford Coupe is a limited edition diecast toy vehicle from the Hot Wheels Treasure Hunt series. This 1:64 scale model features a classic Ford Coupe design in a vibrant orange color, making it a sought-after collectible for car enthusiasts and Hot Wheels collectors. The detailed craftsmanship and unique features of this limited edition piece make it a valuable addition to any diecast toy vehicle collection.
